notes: The italic even is added because the clause writes no object marker on the ends of the earth (rule 16).
majesty is his: the preposition holds no English of its own, so it fuses with its suffix and carries the copula (rule 49); rule 2 does not split it, since only the suffix holds a word.
all of them is the whole English rendering of יַחְדָּו, headed on all under rule 24.
